title: Ruthless Bar Salts Jewel Mint 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Jewel Mint delivers a crisp and refreshing mint flavour, striking the perfect balance between cool spearmint and an icy menthol breeze. The smooth, delicate sweetness paired with cool sensation that lingers on the exhale, making this an ideal choice for vapers who enjoy a pure and uncomplicated mint experience. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid is optimised for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, providing a consistently smooth vape with a satisfying balance of flavour and vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a comfortable throat hit and fast nicotine absorption for an effortless all-day vape. Ruthless are one of the most influential brands in American e-liquids, known for crafting bold and unique flavours that have inspired the industry for years. Their expertly blended shortfills and nic salts continue to be a favourite among vapers on both sides of the pond who prize high-quality, distinct and flavourful e-liquids that push the boundaries of what’s possible in vape juice.
